ios.desc:
Habits helps you keeping track and achieving your goals, by allowing you to customize them the most while keeping a simple and intuitive UI and user experience. 
Several graphs and statistics will help you understanding and analyzing your results!

== Handling simple habits ==

Practicing every three days, playing the guitar four times a week, read a book every week end or revising your exams every day : create and save these habits in a matter of seconds, and update them with a simple tap.

== Handling progressive habits ==

Have you drunk your daily liter and a half of water? 
Achieve your goals progressively by indicating your daily target, and fill your progress gradually to remember what you have already done. 

== Statistics ==

For every habit, you can access a statistics page containing essential data to help you understanding and improving it :
- The main evolution, day after day, by day, week, month, trimester or year.
- An immediate visual of your daily results,
- Your best uninterrupted streaks,
- And lastly, your best week days for every month.

== Notifications ==

You can setup notifications for every habit as a reminder. 

== Your personal data ==

Absolutely none of your personal data created with this application will be sent to any server, it will stay stored in your phone only. 
However, we grant you the ability to export it and keep a backup of your data, to re-import it if needed.  


Thank you for using Habits! Don’t hesitate contacting us to report a problem or proposing new ideas in order to constantly improve the app, at habitude-support@robbeyroad.com

quotes.text:
There is basically copy paste iphone app of “Loop habit tracker”: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1471303896

I’ve spent so much time trying to find Loop replacement and somehow stumbled upon this one. You can even use exports from Loop with some script I found on reddit.

It works ok, but I would love official Loop app for ios.
quotes.story_title: The Simple Guide to Building and Breaking Habits
